evidence.curator_note: Eq 8.1, middle pathway: the pent-1-ene molecular ion (middle folded structure, (30%), dHf/IE 9.3(9.5)) fragments by the arrow labeled 'alpha' (rate 1.7) to the neutral ethyl radical C2H5. (dHf 1.2) plus the C3H5+ allyl cation drawn as +CH2-CH=CH2 ((45%), dHf/IE 9.8(8.1)). Allylic (alpha) cleavage: the C3-C4 bond one removed from the terminal double bond breaks, ejecting the ethyl group and leaving the resonance-stabilized allyl cation. Book draws 0 curved arcs (energetics scheme). All 3 fishhooks reconstructed for balance: (1) the odd electron on C2 forms the new C2=C3 pi bond, (2) one electron of the breaking C3-C4 sigma bond also forms that pi bond, (3) the other electron of C3-C4 departs with C4 as the ethyl radical. LOCALIZATION (convention C): the book draws pent-1-ene as an intact alkene with a delocalized (+.); encoded here as the opened distonic form with the charge on the terminal C1 and the odd electron on C2. Note this is the OPPOSITE terminal-carbon localization from records IMS8-EQ8.1a/f, which need the odd electron on the terminal carbon to drive their H-abstractions -- both are legitimate resonance forms of the same pent-1-ene(+.), each chosen to give that record's arrows a real origin.

Cross-linked MOD rule IMS_8_1_var2_step1 ('monomolecular ion-cleavage 8.1 alpha 1.7'), verified against this scheme. Its DFS '1-pentene >> [C]2..[C.]5.. . [C+]8([H]9)([H]10)[C]11([H]12){=}[C]13([H]14)([H]15)' cleaves the C5-C8 bond (my C3-C4) to give the ethyl radical CH3-CH2. (their C2-C5) and the allyl cation +CH2-CH=CH2 (their C8-C11=C13, charge on the terminal C8). CONNECTIVITY AND LOCALIZATION MATCH this record exactly (my C1 = their C8 carries the charge, my C2=C3 = their C11=C13 the double bond); the cleaved bond is incident to the pi-forming carbon. Clean correspondence.

Book prints '(45%)' relative abundance next to the C3H5+ allyl cation. observed_mz 41.0386 is the curator-computed electron-mass-corrected monoisotopic m/z of C3H5+ (m/z 41); the page prints only the % abundance and dHf/IE (9.8(8.1) eV), no m/z.
